                                    ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 1-H in the area bounded by:

   West Chicago Avenue;
   a line 27.75 feet west of and parallel to North Paulina Street;
   the alley next south of and parallel to West Chicago Avenue; and
   a line 53.25 feet west of and parallel to North Paulina Street;

to those of B3-2 Community Shopping District, which is hereby established in the area
above described.


SECTION 2: This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.
